# Genuine Bazel 9.3.0 (--batch --ignore_all_rc_files, `build --nobuild --noshow_progress
# --curses=no --color=no`), the sorted `print()` texts (DEBUG lines without their
# `DEBUG: <WS>/defs.bzl:L:C: ` lead).
### build //:p //:a //:e
E asp data.txt exe=data.txt same=True runfiles=[] files=["data.txt"] asp=-
E asp gen exe=gen.sh same=True runfiles=["gen.sh"] files=["gen.sh"] asp=@@//:gen
E asp tool exe=tool.sh same=True runfiles=["data.txt", "tool.sh"] files=["tool.sh"] asp=@@//:tool
E asp wrapped exe=wrapped same=True runfiles=["gen.sh", "wrapped"] files=["wrapped"] asp=@@//:wrapped
E empty data.txt exe=data.txt same=True runfiles=[] files=["data.txt"] asp=-
E empty gen exe=gen.sh same=True runfiles=["gen.sh"] files=["gen.sh"] asp=-
E empty tool exe=tool.sh same=True runfiles=["data.txt", "tool.sh"] files=["tool.sh"] asp=-
E empty wrapped exe=wrapped same=True runfiles=["gen.sh", "wrapped"] files=["wrapped"] asp=-
E plain data.txt exe=data.txt same=True runfiles=[] files=["data.txt"] asp=-
E plain gen exe=gen.sh same=True runfiles=["gen.sh"] files=["gen.sh"] asp=-
E plain tool exe=tool.sh same=True runfiles=["data.txt", "tool.sh"] files=["tool.sh"] asp=-
E plain wrapped exe=wrapped same=True runfiles=["gen.sh", "wrapped"] files=["wrapped"] asp=-
